name: Google Bristow

timeline.event: Building 1 is operational, based off of colored motion artifacts from cooling towers. Building 2 is undergoing construction.
Building 2 is operational, based off it being at least 12 months since the roof was complete. Building 3 is finishing construction of cooling towers.
Building 3 is operational, based off of colored motion artifacts from cooling towers.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Google Bristow: current power 238 MW; owner Google.

explain: Google Bristow is an operating AI data center in Bristow, VA, owned by google. Epoch AI estimates it draws 238 MW today and 286 MW when finished.
